hardRules: Preserve artist_music, private music storage, stream access, Jukebox, mobile playback, and existing music surfaces.
Classify every transaction before enabling bids, subscriptions, closing, or tokenization.
Separate direct asset transactions from securities and fund interests.
Tourify does not hold cash or securities, exercise investment discretion, or operate an unapproved matching engine.
Official providers control ownership, custody, NAV, capital accounts, execution, and settlement.
Eligibility and transfer controls default to deny.
Use additive migrations, RLS, restricted storage, immutable versions, and compensating records.
No permissionless tokens, anonymous wallets, leverage, derivatives, lending, rehypothecation, bridges, or AMMs.
Every workflow requires feature flags, kill switches, testing evidence, and rollback instructions.
